meta.dataset: Major waste disposal sites, Delhi NCT, India
meta.method: Name + bounded-viewbox queries, countrycodes=in; results kept only when OSM returned an explicit named feature inside the Delhi NCT bbox (28.40,76.84–28.88,77.35). See scripts/fetch-osm-infrastructure.mjs to reproduce.
meta.note: Only three major sites are explicitly mapped/named in OSM for Delhi; smaller dhalaos, dustbins and kabadiwala shops are largely unmapped, so they are honestly absent rather than invented. Coordinates are site centroids from OSM way geometries.
